stage1.impression: A well-planned, legible night room (beams, counter, record wall, banquette with Orbs), but it reads as a competent CG visualization rather than a photograph: the brightest thing in the frame is a near-white oval spotlight projection on the left wall, which pulls the eye away from the globe hanging in front of it. Mother EARF itself reads as thin neon hoops round a brownish bubble, not as six thick, glowing cast discs. The floor has large, smeary cloud-like blotches, the speakers in the back-bar niches sink into black, and the shopfront is an empty void. Mother EARF and the record-wall niches make this a specific place on paper; as it stands, a magazine would see a nicely furnished generic render, not a place it would publish.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must be the brightest saturated object and read as six thick polished acrylic discs with glowing rims, not as wire hoops (globe region lum_median >= 55 while its wall projection is no brighter than about 140)
The coloured shadow on the concrete must read as saturated tinted light on warm concrete, not as a near-white theatrical gobo (no p95 above about 200 inside it)
The Tropos speakers in the niches must read at a glance: silhouette, smoke tint and horn legible, with no crushed blacks in the niche
The floor must read as real concrete at 1:1 (fine aggregate, trowel marks, a soft sheen with pools of light), not as large-scale procedural cloud blotches
The shopfront and street must show some life (a street lamp, a reflection in the glass) instead of a black void
The counter front and the screens on the left wall must read as materials and images, not as a black slab and blank grey boards
A visible sign of real air and life: a little haze in the spot's beam, and props readable at the counter

defects.what: Mother EARF's projected shadow is a near-white oval (median 181, p95 234) with pastel colour: the brightest, most theatrical element in the frame, reads as a stage gobo and upstages the globe
The globe reads as thin neon wire hoops round a brownish, murky bubble; the 25 mm disc faces are not legible, rims glow weakly (median 38), it looks like a CG wireframe or signage
A small white dome right above the globe competes with it and reads as a stray fitting
The floor has large low-frequency cloud blotches and streaks like wrinkled fabric or water stains, with no aggregate or trowel scale: reads as procedural noise
The right niche's Tropos speaker is mostly crushed (crush_pct 12.5, median 23); its tint and horn are not readable
The left niche speaker's woofer is legible but it reads as a generic black box speaker, with no smoke-acrylic quality visible
The shopfront and street beyond are a black void (median 5.3, crush_pct 18): no street, no reflections
The sculpted counter's front falls to near black (median 10.5) on its curved end; the fluting is lost
The brass foot rail at the counter's curved end looks detached and offset from the counter base
The left-wall screen is a flat light-grey board (median 92) with a vague dark blob: reads as a blank panel, not an image
The ceiling beams are uniformly orange-red (b_median 8), over-saturated, competing with the one-colour rule
Overall gritty noise and a slight smeared denoiser texture on walls and floor at 1:1

changes.problem: Mother EARF's hard spot throws a near-white oval that is the brightest thing in the frame, which makes it read as stage lighting and pulls the eye off the globe.

evidence.measured: lum_median 181, p95 233.6; the globe in front of it measures only 38

changes.expected: The coloured shadow reads as tinted light on warm concrete, more saturated, at roughly half its present brightness, and the oval no longer dominates

changes.problem: The globe's polished rims barely glow, so the discs read as thin coloured hoops round a murky bubble rather than six thick glowing slabs.

evidence.measured: lum_median 38, p95 89; disc faces brown (r 51, g 33, b 27)

changes.expected: Every rim glows its own tint and the globe becomes the clear hero of the left half

changes.problem: The Tropos speakers in the back-bar niches, the altar of the room, fall into black and their smoke tint and horn are unreadable.

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area
change.to: 7.0 W/m2 at the target, plus the lit niche's strip from 3.0 to 4.5

changes.expected: Both niche speakers read in silhouette, with light through the smoked acrylic and the batts faintly visible

changes.problem: The concrete floor has metre-scale cloud blotches that read as procedural noise, not poured and trowelled concrete.

evidence.measured: lum_range 91.8 driven by large dark blotches; visual at 2x: smeared streaks, no aggregate

change.setting: the floor's polish and the concrete's tone
change.to: mottle contrast cut by about 60% and its scale reduced about 4x, plus fine aggregate and trowel arcs, a satin sheen (roughness about 0.35) so the Dome downlights pool and reflect

changes.expected: The floor reads as sealed concrete with soft pools of light under the pendants and stools

changes.problem: The shopfront is a black void, so the room has no street, no depth and no sense of a real San Francisco storefront.

change.setting: street lamps, and the window's etched name
change.to: two sodium-warm street lamps (2200 K) beyond the glass at low level; the etched name at 0.03

changes.expected: A dim warm street glow and faint reflections in the glass behind the EARF lettering, so the room reads as deep and real

changes.problem: The grade crushes the counter's curved front and over-saturates the beams orange-red.

evidence.measured: counter front lum_median 10.5; ceiling [0,0,1200,250] r 49 g 21 b 8

change.to: AgX - Base Contrast, white_balance_k 3000, with the sink's under-glow raised from 0.8 to 1.4 to graze the fluting

changes.expected: The fluting on the counter front reads, and the fir beams turn warm brown instead of orange

changes.problem: The left-wall screen reads as a flat light-grey board, not an image, and pulls the eye to the frame edge.
changes.expected: The screens sit back as dark, quiet images below the globe's brightness

changes.problem: The air is perfectly clear, so the hard spot has no beam and the room lacks the atmosphere of a working bar at night.

evidence.measured: lum_median 37.7, flat range 39.5; no visible beam anywhere

changes.expected: A faint shaft from the hard spot and soft cones under the Domes, with no milky veil

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read thicker or more solid (wider rims, denser tint in the faces)
out_of_scope.why: It is EARF's product and the room's centrepiece, fixed by the card; only its rim glow and light can change

out_of_scope.request: Reattach the brass foot rail flush with the counter's curved base
out_of_scope.why: The counter is fixed room design; if the offset is a modelling error, the model owner should fix it, but it is not a critic change

out_of_scope.request: Remove or move the small white dome fitting directly above the globe
out_of_scope.why: The pendants and their layout are fixed design; only its brightness can change
